args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate ~18%). SRE agent identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release and initiated a rollback. The orchestrated rollback partially completed (us-east only) and halted due to an orchestrator error; a direct deploy of v2.3.0 was then used to complete the rollback. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, service is healthy, and error rate is back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 regression and the rollback orchestrator failure.
